svg.title: Ambient Orchestration — sequence diagram
svg.desc: Sequence diagram showing the runtime message flow between __main__, AmbientOrchestratorAgent, FlightAgent, committee agents, MCP tools, DSPy composer, CalendarAgent and SQLite DB for one poll cycle.
svg.text: loop [poll < MAX_POLLS and window not expired]
alt status == landed / cancelled → return True (stop)
alt on_time or delay < 30 min → silent cycle, sleep, next poll
alt adjusted_p >= 0.60 → soft heads-up or silent. return False
sleep POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS, then next poll iteration
end loop (landed / cancelled / max polls / window expired)
